raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer with strong experience in logo design and visual identity to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in logo design, branding, visual communication, typography, and layout to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, you'll work across a variety of visual design tasks, with a particular focus on logo design, brand identity, and visual concept development. You may also work on layouts, infographics, social media templates, one-pagers, and other marketing and communication assets. We are looking for a versatile designer who can translate ideas and brand concepts into clear, distinctive visual solutions while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency across different formats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design distinctive, professional logos and visual identity concepts based on different brand requirements and creative briefs.
  • Explore and develop multiple logo directions, using strong conceptual thinking to translate brand ideas into effective visual symbols and systems.
  • Apply branding principles across different assets to maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
  • Create clean layouts, modern infographics, and clear visual hierarchies to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design reusable templates for social media channels, marketing materials, and impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
  • Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note

Please submit your CV in English. Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with relevant graphic design work. Portfolios featuring strong logo design and visual identity projects will be particularly important for this role. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional graphic design work, with relevant examples of logo design, branding, or visual identity development. We are particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate the ability to create original logo concepts and translate brand ideas into effective visual solutions. A broader portfolio showcasing formats such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, and one-pagers is also highly valued. We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, color, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Logo & Identity Design: Proven ability to develop original logo concepts and visual identities, from initial exploration through polished final execution.
  • Branding: Strong understanding of brand identity principles, including typography, color, visual language, consistency, and practical application across different formats.
  • Concept Development: Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate abstract brand ideas into distinctive, relevant, and visually effective concepts.
  • Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
  • Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
  • Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

Additional requirements

  • An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

raw.description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon is the WebOps platform for websites that deliver extraordinary results. We believe in putting the magic of the internet in everyone's hands. That's why we're so passionate about helping developers, IT and marketing develop, test, and release website changes faster and more reliably so they can build and maintain websites that create value for their organizations. Our cloud native software makes it easy to securely manage a single website or thousands of websites across multiple teams in one platform.

Pantheon's core company values are Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First. At Pantheon, we work hard and play harder, valuing individuality, humor, and balance. We're enthusiastic participants in several open-source communities and have real relationships with many of our most active customers. If all of this sounds interesting to you, read on!

The Role

Pantheon is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Connectivity & API Transformation team. We're expanding an impressive and growing platform that powers hundreds of thousands of websites, millions of containerized resources, billions of monthly page views, and development tools that professional website developers use.

Our team owns the connective tissue of that platform: the federated GraphQL API that every Pantheon surface is built on, the network layer and discovery patterns that let our services find and reach each other, the orchestration layer that runs customer-facing automation, and the ongoing work of decomposing our legacy core into well-bounded modern services. It's a role with unusual leverage — the interfaces and pathways you design become the contract that every other engineering team at Pantheon builds against.

Pantheon's core company values are Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First. Additionally, the Pantheon engineering teams are built around a focus on collaboration, character, autonomy, and a no-blame culture. We're enthusiastic participants in several open-source communities and have real relationships with many of our most active customers.

If all of this sounds interesting to you, read on!

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and evolving Pantheon's unified API — a federated GraphQL supergraph (Grafbase, Federation v2) and the Go subgraphs behind it that serve our Dashboard and public API
  • Shaping how Pantheon's services find and reach one another — VPC and network architecture, service discovery strategy, and the connectivity standards our internal traffic runs on
  • Decomposing a large legacy Python monolith into well-bounded services, and owning the Cassandra data layer behind it — replication, backup, and disaster recovery
  • Designing and operating workflow orchestration at platform scale: GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub-driven job execution, and Go services on Cloud Run that run customer-facing automation
  • Setting the GraphQL, gRPC, and REST standards other Pantheon teams build against, and acting as a technical resource for initiatives across the org
  • Owning your team's production systems — tracking health with SLOs, resolving production issues, and balancing delivery speed against reliability
  • Supporting Pantheon as a member of our on-call engineering rotation and your team's alert response rotation
  • Raising the level of engineers around you through code review, design feedback, and mentorship

What You Need to Succeed

  • Significant work experience building and operating production services in Go, and the adaptability to work in a polyglot codebase — our stack also includes Rust and Python
  • Experience designing APIs that other teams depend on, with real judgment about schema design, versioning, and backward compatibility. GraphQL, gRPC, or REST at scale all count
  • Work-related experience with large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems, and with designing scalable and robust services in the real world
  • Experience carving services out of a monolith, or otherwise evolving a legacy system incrementally while keeping it running
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking fundamentals — VPCs, DNS, load balancing, and service-to-service authentication — and the judgment to make network boundaries a deliberate design choice rather than an accident
  • Understanding and working knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and release engineering practices
  • Experience with a major cloud provider; GCP especially welcome
  • Experience leveraging observability tooling like Grafana Cloud, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry to understand systems in production
  • Experience supporting live sites and participating in on-call
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to represent your contributions and ideas with clarity while remaining open and giving space to the contributions and ideas of others

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with GraphQL Federation, a federation gateway or router (Grafbase, Apollo, Hive), or a schema registry
  • Working knowledge of Rust
  • Experience with Cassandra, or with running a stateful datastore in production — backups, DR, multi-region replication
  • Experience migrating off end-of-life language runtimes (for example, Python 2)
  • Hands-on experience with private service networking or a service mesh — Shared VPC, VPC peering, Private Service Connect, internal DNS, Istio/Envoy
  • Working knowledge of GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Build
  • Working knowledge of AlloyDB, MySQL, Redis
  • Working knowledge of Docker, CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Vault
  • Working knowledge of WordPress, Drupal

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry competitive compensation and equity plan
  • Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave (PSL) and 11 Paid Company Holidays
  • Full medical coverage (Extended health care, dental, vision)
  • Top-of-line equipment
  • Monthly allowance for wellness, reading and access to LinkedIn Learning for continued development
  • Events and activities both team-based and company wide that inspire, educate and cultivate

Compensation: $139,680-$174,600 USD annual salary plus bonus and equity

Pantheon is an equal opportunity action employer and we welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by law. Pantheon complies with federal and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability for any part of the interview process, please contact . Pursuant to local and federal regulations, Pantheon will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

raw.excerpt: The Senior Manager, Total Rewards is a key member of the Human Capital team responsible for executing Bridgeway's compensation and benefits strategy and providing leadership to the HR Operations function.
raw.description:
The Senior Manager, Total Rewards is a key member of the Human Capital team responsible for executing Bridgeway's compensation and benefits strategy and providing leadership to the HR Operations function. While strategic direction is set by and in close partnership with the VP, Human Capital, the Senior Manager brings deep subject matter expertise that positions them to actively inform and influence that strategy. Day-to-day, this role is execution-focused — administering benefits programs, managing compensation planning and the merit cycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving HR operations delivery. The Senior Manager serves as the team's go-to expert on compensation and benefits and operates as a collaborative thought partner to the VP, Human Capital on workforce investment decisions.

This position is remote with preference for East Coast candidates. Occasional travel <5%.

Responsibilities:

Compensation

  • Execute Bridgeway's compensation philosophy, job architecture, and pay equity framework; serve as the organization's subject matter expert on total rewards and actively inform its evolution in partnership with the VP, Human Capital.
  • Lead the annual merit cycle end-to-end, including budget modeling, manager guidance, system configuration, and executive reporting.
  • Analyze compensation surveys; benchmark roles against the market to assess competitiveness and inform pay decisions at all levels.
  • Provide compensation guidance for new hires, promotions, and internal transfers; partner closely with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners on offer recommendations.
  • Support the VP, Human Capital and Finance on total compensation budgeting, workforce cost modeling, and compensation analysis.

Benefits

  • Lead benefits program strategy, design, and ongoing management — including self-funded health, welfare, retirement 401(k), and leave programs — ensuring programs are market-competitive, cost-effective, and fully compliant with applicable regulations.
  • Drive the employee benefits experience end-to-end — open enrollment planning and execution, employee communications, system configuration, and carrier/vendor coordination.
  • Manage the benefits broker, TPA, stop-loss carrier, and 401(k) record keeper relationships and hold all benefits vendors accountable to service standards, contract terms, and deliverables.
  • Ensure benefits and leave programs comply with applicable regulations, including ACA, ERISA, FMLA, and state-specific requirements.

HR Operations

  • Provide day-to-day leadership to the HR Operations function, ensuring high-quality, efficient service delivery across the employee lifecycle.
  • Directly manage, coach, and develop the HR Operations Specialist, setting clear performance expectations and supporting ongoing professional growth.
  • Manage HR regulatory compliance reporting obligations, including ACA filings, EEOC reporting, and IRS/DOL testing requirements.
  • Drive HRIS data integrity standards and identify opportunities for system automation, integration, process improvement, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve HR SOPs and process documentation across Total Rewards and HR Operations.
  • Analyze workforce cost, compensation equity, and benefits utilization data to surface actionable insights and inform strategic decisions.
  • Lead and contribute to human capital projects, including system implementations, program launches, policy updates, and organizational changes.
  • Leverage generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, improve solution quality, and accelerate delivery of business outcomes.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience with demonstrated depth in compensation program design, job architecture, market benchmarking, and incentive design
  • Proven experience managing a full benefits portfolio – including self-funded health plan administration, 401(k)/retirement plan administration, vendor and broker relationships, open enrollment execution, and regulatory compliance
  • Prior experience managing or formally mentoring direct reports with a demonstrated commitment to developing others
  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in compensation data modeling; advanced Excel required
  • Experience with ADP WorkforceNow (HRIS/payroll) and Lattice (performance management) strongly desired; prior experience with comparable platforms in both categories required
  • Solid working knowledge of applicable regulations governing compensation and benefits, including FLSA, ACA, ERISA, FMLA, 401(k)/retirement compliance, and IRS/DOL requirements
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to advise and influence senior leaders with confidence and credibility
  • Operates as a player-coach — executes hands-on with high autonomy while bringing enough strategic depth to serve as a credible thought partner to the VP, Human Capital
  • High degree of discretion, integrity, and independent judgment in handling sensitive and confidential information
  • Experience using generative AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to improve productivity and deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related discipline required
  • CCP (Certified Compensation Professional) or CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist) strongly preferred; HRCI or SHRM certification a plus

Bridgeway is an Equal Opportunity Employer

raw.description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer with strong experience in logo design and visual identity to join the Tendem project (** and create high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in logo design, branding, visual communication, typography, and layout to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, you'll work across a variety of visual design tasks, with a particular focus on logo design, brand identity, and visual concept development. You may also work on layouts, infographics, social media templates, one-pagers, and other marketing and communication assets. We are looking for a versatile designer who can translate ideas and brand concepts into clear, distinctive visual solutions while maintaining a high level of craft and consistency across different formats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design distinctive, professional logos and visual identity concepts based on different brand requirements and creative briefs.
  • Explore and develop multiple logo directions, using strong conceptual thinking to translate brand ideas into effective visual symbols and systems.
  • Apply branding principles across different assets to maintain a consistent and recognizable visual identity.
  • Create clean layouts, modern infographics, and clear visual hierarchies to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design reusable templates for social media channels, marketing materials, and impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
  • Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note

Please submit your CV in English. Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with relevant graphic design work. Portfolios featuring strong logo design and visual identity projects will be particularly important for this role. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio demonstrating professional graphic design work, with relevant examples of logo design, branding, or visual identity development. We are particularly interested in designers who can demonstrate the ability to create original logo concepts and translate brand ideas into effective visual solutions. A broader portfolio showcasing formats such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, infographics, and one-pagers is also highly valued. We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, color, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Logo & Identity Design: Proven ability to develop original logo concepts and visual identities, from initial exploration through polished final execution.
  • Branding: Strong understanding of brand identity principles, including typography, color, visual language, consistency, and practical application across different formats.
  • Concept Development: Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate abstract brand ideas into distinctive, relevant, and visually effective concepts.
  • Layout & Typography: Exceptional grasp of typography, precise grid systems, and visual composition to elevate everyday materials.
  • Visual Asset Creation: Proven ability to structure information cleanly through modern infographics and compelling social media templates.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
  • Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

Additional requirements

  • An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with graphic design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant graphic design cases, will not be considered.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

JOBPROFILE DESCRIPTION

Kainos is recognised as one of the UK’s leading AI and data businesses, with a decade-longtrack recordof delivering impactful, production-grade AI solutions for clients across government, healthcare,defence,and commercial sectors. Kainos is at the forefront of AI innovation,trusted by Microsoft,AWS,andothersto deliveradvanced AIand datasolutions atcitizenscale.

Our150-strong AI and DataPracticebringstogether deepexpertisein machine learning, generative AI,agenticAIand data.We are pioneers in responsible AI, having authored the UK government’s AI Cyber Security Code of Practice implementation guideand we partner with leading organisations to ensure AI is deployed ethically, securely and with measurable business value. Our teams are at thecutting edgeof AI research,and delivery, it istruly an exciting team to join Kainos aswe further grow our AI capability.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE&RESPONSIBILITIES IN THE BUSINESS:

As a Lead AI Engineer at Kainos, you will architect,design,and deliver advanced AI solutionsleveragingstate-of-the-artmachine learning,generativeand agenticAI technologies. You will drive the adoption of modern AI frameworks,AIOps best practicesand scalable cloud-native architectures. Your role will involve hands-on technical leadership, collaborating with customers to translate business challenges into trustworthy AI solutionsandensuring responsible AI practices throughout.As a technical mentor, you will foster a culture of innovation, continuouslearning,and engineering excellence.

It isa fast-pacedenvironment,so it is important foryou to make sound, reasoned decisions.You willdo this whilst learning aboutnewtechnologiesand approaches, with talented colleagues that will help you todevelop and grow. You will manage,coach,and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managingemployee performance andassistingin their career development.You willalso providedirection and leadership for your team as you solve challenging problems together.

MINIMUM(ESSENTIAL)REQUIREMENTS:

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to lead client projects andestablishrequirements in non-technical language.

  • We are passionate about developing people, you will bring experienceinmanaging,coaching,and developing junior members ofateam and widercommunity.

DESIRABLE:

Embracing our differences

raw.description:
Industry Marketing Director - Legal

We are looking for a dynamic leader to drive the GTM positioning, messaging, and thought leadership that will grow Intapp's Legal business—our largest and most established vertical. As Director of Legal Industry Marketing, you will develop compelling and prescriptive thought leadership, create industry GTM content/sales collateral, and provide strategic deal support for Intapp’s largest client opportunities. You will partner with a diverse ecosystem—Industry Principals, Solution Product Marketers, Sales, Field Marketing, and Demand Generation—to build Intapp's legal value proposition and drive a coordinated go-to-market strategy. You will position the company as the trusted voice on the transformation of legal services and a strategic partner for firms navigating AI adoption, profitability pressures, and the evolving business of law.

This is a role for someone who enjoys building C-level relationships to help advise firm leaders on how to achieve success in their strategic transformation programs. This is a Director-level individual contributor role, ideal for an experienced product marketing leader who thrives on both strategy and execution. Reporting to the VP of Portfolio & Industry Marketing, you will own both the industry narrative and the hands-on execution that turns thought leadership into pipeline and revenue growth.

What you will do:

Develop bold, differentiated industry thought leadership:

  • Own the annual messaging architecture for the legal vertical—defining the strategic themes that connect industry challenges to Intapp's differentiated value and drive one coordinated story across all channels.

  • Create and deliver differentiated thought leadership, backed by proprietary data or research, that positions Intapp as the industry benchmark and defines what "great" looks like for a modern, AI-enabled law firm. Partner with cross-functional SME’s such as Industry Principals, Growth Directors, and Practice Group Leaders to develop content.

  • Create CXO perspectives on trends shaping the legal market. Examples could include: AI transformation, matter economics and pricing pressure, risk and compliance complexity, client development and relationship intelligence, and the shift toward connected, data-driven firm operations.

  • Develop keynote content and secure speaking opportunities for you and Intapp senior SMEs at marquee industry events (e.g., ILTACON, LegalTech, ACC) to establish Intapp's thought leadership position.

  • Partner with PR team to amplify Intapp’s voice in the legal market, building relationships with analysts, media, and industry influencers to validate our differentiation and elevate market perception.

  • Partner with demand gen/ growth marketing to activate industry ABM campaigns to drive customer engagement and sales growth

Lead the Legal GTM positioning and execution to grow the business:

  • Build and maintain the legal industry bill of materials: competitive positioning, sales plays, executive pitch decks, library of use cases, vision demos, client proof points, and competitive positioning that drive pipeline and improve win rates.

  • Partner with Solution Product Marketers to create unified portfolio messaging for legal buyers, ensuring a cohesive story rather than disconnected product narratives.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional execution: partner with Industry Principals to co-create authoritative content, Field & Event Marketing to execute industry moments, Demand Generation to activate ABM campaigns, and Sales Enablement to equip the field with best-in-class collateral and training.

  • Support GTM planning for product launches at the industry level, translating platform capabilities into legal-specific value propositions.

  • Support competitive intelligence and win/loss analysis to inform positioning, GTM strategy, and product roadmap priorities.

  • Track performance using leading indicators (content consumption, event engagement), middle-funnel metrics (share of voice, analyst perception, target account engagement), and lagging indicators (pipeline influenced, win rate correlation, deal velocity).

Engage directly in strategic deal pursuits (15-25% of time):

  • Support large, strategic deals by developing custom presentations, executive messaging, and competitive positioning that opens doors and advances deals.

  • Join executive briefings and finalist presentations, bringing industry expertise and thought leadership credibility to high-stakes client engagements.

  • Collaborate with Sales on strategic account planning, identifying opportunities to leverage industry insights and content to deepen client relationships and drive cross-sell.

What you will need:

Your success is measured by driving growth in Intapp's Legal vertical—setting the vision for AI-powered transformation in the market and positioning Intapp as a key strategic partner in this process.

  • Ideal candidate has 10-15+ years of experience in management consulting, product or industry marketing, and/or legal operations (e.g., law firm operations, legal technology, practice management)

  • Has worked in high-growth enterprise SaaS and AI environments, including expertise in portfolio messaging or vertical marketing strategies

  • Knowledge of areas such as legal operations, business development, matter economics, pricing, AI/automation, or risk & compliance.

  • Knowledge of law firm business models, buyer personas (Managing Partners, CFOs, CIOs, Practice Group Leaders, General Counsel), and the competitive landscape in legal technology.

  • Demonstrated track record developing high-profile thought leadership that builds market credibility and drives business results—ideally including published perspectives, conference speaking, and visibility in industry channels.

  • Outstanding executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire and engage senior-level executives

  • Entrepreneurial approach to finding new growth levers for the business, with strong problem-solving skills and talent for conducting research, analyzing data, executive storytelling/messaging, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations.

  • Exceptional written communication, including interest in authoring thought-provoking points-of-view and conducting customer and market research.

  • Highly collaborative with ability to lead through influence and orchestrate cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% for client meetings, executive briefings, and industry events.

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA, JD, or advanced degree preferred.

What you will gain:

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We'll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.

  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

Your actual base salary will be determined by factors such as relevant experience, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, variable compensation and equity may also be included.

Intapp provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and will make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please note: Intapp will not hire through text message, social media, or email alone. We will never extend a job offer unless you have been contacted directly by an Intapp recruiter and have participated in the interview process which will generally consist of 3 or more virtual or in person meetings. Please note that Intapp only uses company email addresses, which contain “@intapp.com” or “@dealcloud.com” to communicate with candidates via email. Intapp will never ask for financial information of any kind or for any payment during the job application process. We post all legitimate job openings on the Intapp Career Site at . raw.description:
Provider Tax Data Integrity team, work towards improving quality of data in Cigna's Provider Book of Record (BoR) system, by working together with our business partners, to create exceptional data experience for Cigna and our customers. The focus is the execution of strategic vision for enterprise data, and the delivery of quality automation, strengthens our journey to provide one of the most reliable provider data experiences in the industry.

The Provider Relations Sr. Analyst role sits within this team in Provider Service and Operations organization, working across the business community, partnering closely with IT to improve data quality and developing automation capabilities which transforms data, algorithms and processes into most reliable one stop shop for provider data.

Responsibilities:

  • Writes business, functional and non-functional business requirements, actively participates in system design reviews, reviews test evidence, and participates in status meetings
  • Identifies data elements required for provider data loading to PRIME (BoR)
  • Understands all aspects of provider/practitioner demographics, contracts, contract management and PRIME domains
  • Develops understanding of existing BoR system (PRIME) and other BoR related to HCPM
  • Determines load type (update or new) based on data analysis
  • Collaborate with matrix partners to review outcomes and ensure accurate loading guidelines
  • Identifies remediation needs to promote increased automated loading of provider data and to support data integrity across all provider systems
  • Reviews validated data elements to ensure quality of data before BoR ingestion
  • Guide the team in following system process flows

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher strongly preferred or equivalent work experience.
  • Dedicated to innovation and designing new ways to work
  • Knowledge and understanding of Provider Data Domains
  • Knowledge of PRIME contractual structure preferred
  • Ability to locate and analyze HCP data and perform data maintenance for accurate consumption; ability to extract criteria through data analytics when top-down extraction is not possible.
  • Be a team player and able to work independently or with little supervision
  • Experience in health care/managed care with direct responsibility for quality analytics and data management with relational database concepts
  • Expertise in the use of relational database concepts and applications, specifically use of SAS EG, SQL databases and tools, MS Office Suite
  • Proficiency with Structured Query Language (SQL) procedure as a data retrieval tool. Specifically, the ability to write programs to perform queries on data and retrieve data from multiple tables/sources like Hadoop, SQL server and Teradata with SAS and SQL
  • Ability to navigate organization, build SME relationships and assist with internal discussions
  • Strong data mining skills including the ability to perform research and conduct root cause analyses
  • 1+ years of experience as a Business System Analyst highly preferred

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 58,100 - 96,900 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.

Advisory Services Intern

What you will be doing:

The Intern works collaboratively within a team of highly qualified Advisory consultants to deliver performance improvement to healthcare systems. This position will be primarily responsible for performing billable work for client engagements and internal opportunities. The role of the Intern is to actively participate within an engagement team to determine our client’s needs, analyze and interpret data, evaluate potential solutions, develop presentation materials, and assist in the implementation of recommended improvements.

The Intern participates in all aspects of an engagement including identifying issues, forming hypotheses, planning and participating in interviews, conducting analyses, synthesizing conclusions into insights and recommendations, synthesizing information into cohesive presentations for various audiences and helping to implement change. The intern will work in a team environment and provide input and support to team deliverables and presentations during each phase of a project.

The Intern may interact with clients and is expected to build working relationships within the Premier/Client team. This position takes a broad approach to problem solving and develops an understanding of our client’s needs and expectations.

Interns will also participate in Premier internal activities including practice development, required and approved educational opportunities, and learning the various technologies Premier offers to its clients.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1 – 75%

  • Generate billings revenue by conducting assigned analyses, write and prepare reports, and assist clients in implementing desired changes at the direction of team leadership.

  • Define detailed business requirements by working in tandem with team members to effectively interview clients to clarify project objectives; document customer “wants” and “needs”.

  • Create and prepare presentations and deliverables for client audiences that communicate strategy and outcomes at the direction of team leadership.

  • Deliver content for projects in a timely and quality manner.

  • Create required deliverables as it relates to internship requirements to showcase new and learned skillsets.

Responsibility #2 – 15%

  • Network with peers and colleagues across the Advisory Services practice and broader Premier network.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

If you're a growth-focused marketer with a passion for e-commerce and a knack for driving customer engagement, wed love to hear from you!

ISSA is looking for a Controller!

Please note: 100% Remote position (must reside in an ISSA-eligible state: (AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, NC, NV, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI).

About ISSA: ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more! For over 35 years, ISSA has developed a personal fitness training program that combines gym experience with practical, applied science. With over 300 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries. We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!

We are adding a Controller to our team of relationship-builders, laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into everyday life!

So What's the Job?

  • As the Controller at ISSA, reporting to the CFO, you will be responsible for the oversight of all accounting and accounting operational activities. As a hands-on yet strategic leader, you will oversee the day-to-day accounting operations while developing processes and utilizing technology to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the accounting cycle. You will partner with organizational leaders to drive implementation of new projects and ensure financial compliance across the organization.

Build and Lead a World-Class Accounting Organization:

  • Develop team structure and roles required to support the accounting and accounting operations needs of the entire organization. Build Job Descriptions and related plans and work with Recruitment to fill open roles, as needed.
  • Champion a culture of innovation and creativity to automate and find efficiencies and scalability opportunities
  • Leadership and management of a high-performing team with focus on individual development, efficient prioritization, and delivery of high-quality output while meeting key deadlines

Accounting

  • Manage the accounting close processes and consolidations to meet internal and external deadlines
  • Prepare financials in both GAAP and Bookings basis for internal and external audiences, meeting internal and external deadlines
  • Oversee all accounts, ledgers, and reporting systems ensuring compliance with GAAP standards, regulatory requirements, and lender covenants
  • Coordinate and manage the annual audit and tax prep engagements and related required reporting
  • Ensure and document appropriate internal controls and separation of duties

Accounting Operations

  • Oversee cash management functions, treasury, and daily banking
  • Maintain annual and 13-Week Cash Forecast and provide insights into variances between actual and forecast
  • Oversee the Accounts Payable Function, including vendor management, 1099 reporting, accurate and timely processing of invoices and payments, and employee expense reports
  • Oversee management of corporate credit card programs
  • Oversee Accounts Receivable function as related to non-standard contracts

Tax & Compliance

  • Manage sales tax automation software
  • Oversee Sales Tax Analysis and Assessment
  • Guide the implementation and setup of ongoing registrations for all required tax filings, including income and payroll
  • Design a process for continued monitoring and compliance with new tax and business registration requirements.
  • Coordinate and manage annual income tax engagement
  • Oversee accuracy and timeliness of all payroll-related filings, regulations, and compliance items

Strategic Improvements and Efficiencies

  • Partner with the Technology team to design new processes across the order-to-cash phase of accounting to align with new technology solutions, up to and including identification of a new ERP
  • Decrease days to close from 8 to 3
  • Utilize technology to automate reconciliations, entries, and reporting
  • Enhance efficiencies related to GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition methodology and processes
  • Provide strategic, implementation, and due diligence support related to M&A targets
  • Migrate ownership of payroll function from HR to Finance and oversee payroll administration function

What is ISSA looking for?

  • 10+ years of relevant, progressive experience required, with 2+ years of experience as a Controller
  • 3+ years of experience in public accounting with a “Big 8” firm, ideally in audit, preferred
  • Experience in an eCommerce business environment with a deep understanding of performance marketing preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance and CPA required, MBA a plus
  • Strong understanding of GAAP and IFRS
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage technology to improve processes
  • Experience managing financial systems selection and implementation/integration
  • Experience with Private Equity ownership and M&A Transactions preferred
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, Jet Reports, and Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is a plus
  • Highest standards of accuracy and precision as well as excellent organizational skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to clearly communicate with different levels in the organization
  • Ability to communicate complex financial concepts to non-financial audiences
  • Strong work ethic and a high sense of urgency are required
  • Must be a self-starter and able to work independently
  • Self-starter who is intellectually curious and not afraid to seek out projects independently
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Passion for health, fitness, nutrition, or personal training is a definite plus!

WHO is ISSA looking for?

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA, we're looking for the same kind of person.

  • Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
  • Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
  • Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
  • Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.

We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.

We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks:

This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:

Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? After 90 days, employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!

Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.

Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members have 3 weeks of PTO each year...accrued on a bi-weekly basis! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday!

Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families. Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component of living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.

Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.

Growth Opportunities: When our people grow…we grow! We offer leadership training, coaching/mentoring opportunities, and cross-functional collaboration on special projects and initiatives. Constant growth and development are inherent in our culture.

Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

100% Remote Work: You can say goodbye to long commutes because all of our roles can be performed from the comfort of your own home. To connect and communicate more effectively, ISSA is a camera-friendly culture in which cameras are on for scheduled meetings. We have found that this bridges the gap that can exist since we are not working together in an office.

What Else? We have a 401(k) company match and 100% company-paid life/AD&D insurance/short-term disability. We also offer an employee assistance program to assist with work-life concerns (legal, financial, and mental health). Our ultimate goal is to support you and your overall wellness.

Transform your career at ISSA!

Verdesian is seeking an individual to fill our remote Account Manager, Sales role in Southern IL. The Account Manager is responsible for growing Verdesian’s retail customer base within assigned territory by selling the full product portfolio. This role focuses on identifying and onboarding new retail partners, providing product training, and supporting adoption through expert guidance. The Account Manager will develop and execute annual territory and business plans, collaborate with VIP customers, and provide accurate sales forecasts to ensure proper product availability. They are expected to manage their operating budgets responsibly and work cross-functionally with Marketing and R&D to align product development with customer needs. Position:

Field Sales Representative II - Upstate New York


Job Description:

Are you passionate about driving purposeful technology innovation?


If so, Arrow Electronics, currently has an exciting opportunity for a Field Sales Rep covering the Upstate New York territory! Arrow Electronics is a Fortune 154 company, globally headquartered in Denver, CO with 22,000 employees worldwide. Arrow brings technology solutions to a breadth of markets, including telecommunications, information systems, transportation, medical, industrial and consumer electronics. We serve as a supply channel partner for over 100,000 original equipment manufacturers, contract manufacturers and commercial customers through a global network.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Defining critical markets and new customers in the assigned sales territory, planning strategy, and developing all key relationships to ensure strong foundation for solution selling within the Aerospace & Defense vertical market.
  • Maintaining and promoting relationships with customer contacts who may be determining design opportunities and deal with existing business challenges.
  • Ensuring customer satisfaction as it pertains to supply chain management and other value-added services.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Knowledge of the assigned market/territory (e.g., customers, competition). Recent industry experience is preferred.
  • Must be already living within the Upstate NY area
  • Ability to promote and sell the value add, supply chain, and full life cycle programs offered by Arrow.
  • Ability to develop strategic plans for all assigned accounts, sell and market the full set of Arrow offerings incorporating in-depth knowledge of Arrow’s key supplier lines. 
  • Proven ability to articulate complex strategies and able to execute on them.
  • Extensive understanding of pricing programs and models within the electronics industry.
  • Experience interacting with vendors and customers in a technical and engineering environment.
  • Ability to prepare comprehensive internal quarterly business reviews (iQBR), presenting strategic plans and implementation steps to grow sales, demand creation and improve customer service, and ability to lead regular QBRs with major customers that unlock additional sales opportunities.
  • Proficiency in sales tracking systems, SalesForce.com, Oracle
  • Innovative self-starters who are willing to challenge the status quo.
  • This role will perform work covered by International Traffic in Arms Regulations. Viable candidates for this position must be eligible for an export license or be a U.S. Person (which includes but is not limited to U.S. citizens or nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees).

Work Arrangement:

  • Fully Remote: Must be able to travel to an Arrow office location as requested by Arrow leadership.
  • Local travel throughout the Upstate NY territory

Education/Experience:

  • 5-7 years of field sales experience required; bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience in Aerospace and Defense industry is required.
  • In-depth understanding of the electronic components industry is preferred.

What’s In It For You:

At Arrow, we recognize that financial rewards and great benefits are important aspects of an ideal job. That’s why we offer competitive financial compensation, including various compensation plans and a solid benefits package.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k, With Matching Contributions
  • Short-Term/Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)/Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) Options
  • Paid Time Off (including sick, holiday, vacation, etc.)
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Growth Opportunities
  • And more!

Annual Hiring Range/Hourly Rate:

$91,900.00 - $140,802.82

Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive (if applicable) will be finalized at offer.


Location:

US-NY-New York (Remote Employees)Remote work employees may be required to be present at the closest designated Arrow office for work-related purposes, at the Company’s request and sole discretion.


Time Type:

Full time


Job Category:

Sales

EEO Statement:

Arrow is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. (Arrow EEO/AAP policy)

All Arrow job postings are for existing job vacancies. We anticipate this requisition will be open for a minimum of five days, though it may be open for a longer period of time. We encourage your prompt application.

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

raw.description:
Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a data-driven CRM expert to join our team supporting a large tech client. In this role, you will serve as the bridge between marketing strategy and technical execution, transforming complex data signals into high-impact customer experiences. You aren’t just building lists; you are architecting the audience logic that powers major APAC promotional campaigns and global product launches. We are looking for a problem-solver who is as comfortable writing SQL queries as they are managing senior stakeholders. If you are passionate about the customer lifecycle and thrive in a collaborative, rapid-fire environment, you’ll fit right in!

This role requires you to work in an APAC-friendly time zone, starting at 5:30 a.m. IST.

Role:

  • Content Thought Leadership & Localisation: Act as a strategic partner to Global teams, shaping upstream content briefs by embedding APAC market insights. Proactively surface region-specific requirements to ensure global assets are designed for local relevance and maximum impact.
  • NPI & Sustain Program Management: Orchestrate the end-to-end localisation and delivery timelines for all New Product Introduction (NPI) training assets. Ensure all markets receive transcreated content—including videos, e-learning modules, and one-pagers—aligned with go-live dates.
  • Vendor & Agency Management: Serve as the primary liaison for transcreation agencies, local reviewers, and field teams. You will ensure linguistic precision and brand voice consistency across Japan, Australia, India, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia, while managing publishing vendors to guarantee on-time delivery.
  • Regional Campaign Development: Identify market-specific training gaps and lead the creation of bespoke, region-led campaigns. You will develop assets that resonate with local retail teams to drive product advocacy and brand engagement.
  • Advocacy & Engagement Programs: Collaborate with local teams to design and localise assets aimed at building 'brand love' among retail staff, managing initiatives such as contests, seeding programs, and gamified engagement.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Channel Sales & Activation (CSA), Retail Sales, and both Local and Global Training teams to ensure all training objectives are perfectly aligned with broader business goals.
  • Platform & Operational Delivery: Oversee the vendor responsible for the upload and distribution of content across various Learning Management Systems (LMS) and internal advocacy platforms.
  • Budget & Performance Tracking: Manage localisation budgets and monitor asset usage rates to measure the efficiency and ROI of the regional training supply chain.

You:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience in Business, Marketing, or Education
  • 12+ years of experience in retail training, trade marketing, or project management.
  • Proven track record of program managing complex projects with strict deadlines, specifically related to NPI or product launches.
  • Experience managing localisation workflows and working with external vendors.
  • Previous experience in the Consumer Electronics or Tech industry.
  • Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and content authoring tools.
  • Strong understanding of regional retail landscapes and cultural nuances across APAC.
  • Highly organised with strong project management capabilities and expert-level proficiency in methodologies and tools like Smartsheet.
  • Ability to methodically maintain trackers and manage complex spreadsheets with high attention to detail.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills and the capacity to build strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Flexibility and the ability to work effectively under ambiguity and uncertainty in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.
  • Strong aptitude for or experience in integrating AI tools into project workflows, with a preference for Google AI tools.
  • High energy and a proactive, "go-getter" attitude focused on teamwork and project success.
  • Exceptional verbal and written English communication and presentation skills.

Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. Where your application contains personal data of third parties, you confirm that you have obtained all necessary consents to provide the Maker Lab team with such personal data and that we may collect, use and/or disclose such data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

raw.title: Senior Manager – SAP Transformation
raw.excerpt: Be part of a high-performance team at cbs Corporate Business Solutions America, where innovation meets expertise in SAP consulting.
raw.description:
Be part of a high-performance team at cbs Corporate Business Solutions America, where innovation meets expertise in SAP consulting.

Whether you're driving new business opportunities in sales or leading transformative projects as a consultant, you’ll be at the forefront of digital innovation. Our culture fosters professional growth, teamwork, and continuous learning, ensuring you have the resources and support to excel.
With a 100% successful go-live rate and a reputation for delivering world-class SAP solutions, cbs is the place to build a rewarding career.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Senior Manager – SAP Transformation to help drive the continued growth of our SAP consulting business in North America.

This is a senior client-facing role combining SAP end-to-end transformation leadership, program management, solution architecture, pre-sales and go-to-market activities and act as a proposal team lead. The successful candidate will bring deep SAP functional and end-to-end process expertise, experience leading complex SAP transformation programs, and a strong understanding of the market and customer landscape.

The role does not initially include direct reports. However, as the business grows, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to build and develop a team and help shape the growth of the practice.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have gained experience across multiple industries and can bring a broader perspective beyond a single sector.

Key Responsibilities:

SAP Transformation & Program Leadership

  • Lead and oversee complex, full life-cycle SAP transformation programs, including SAP M&A and SAP S/4HANA initiatives (Greenfield, Brownfield or SDT – Selective Data Transition).

  • Take responsibility for large SAP engagements and programs with significant scope, complexity, and commercial impact.

  • Manage program delivery across scope, timeline, budget, resources, risks, quality, and customer expectations.

  • Serve as a senior point of contact for customers throughout the transformation lifecycle.

  • Lead executive-level customer discussions, steering committees, program reviews, and escalation management.

  • Translate business objectives into SAP transformation roadmaps and executable programs.

  • Ensure successful coordination across functional, technical, business, and project teams.

Solution & Functional Leadership

  • Bring strong SAP functional expertise combined with end-to-end business process knowledge.

  • Understand dependencies across SAP functional areas and their impact on the overall business transformation.

  • Apply previous experience as a Functional Lead, Lead Consultant, Solution/Lead Architect, or similar role to complex customer environments.

Relevant functional backgrounds may include:

  • SAP Finance / Controlling

  • Supply Chain

  • Manufacturing

  • Logistics


Program & Commercial Responsibility

  • Manage SAP programs and customer engagements contributing toward approximately $5M+ in annual revenue responsibility.

  • Manage project financials, commercial performance, resource requirements, scope changes, and delivery commitments

  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and generate additional consulting business.

Sales, Customer Development & Go-to-Market

  • Develop and maintain senior-level customer relationships and leverage an established professional network to create new business opportunities.

  • Actively contribute to go-to-market (GTM) strategy and execution.

  • Support and lead customer presentations, proposals, solution development, estimates, and sales pursuits.

  • Identify opportunities within both existing and prospective accounts.

  • Partner with sales and consulting leadership to develop new customers and expand strategic accounts

Practice Leadership

  • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and actively contribute to building and expanding the SAP consulting practice.

  • Lead and mentor multidisciplinary SAP consulting teams across functional, technical, and data disciplines.

  • Provide guidance to Project Managers, Solution Architects, Stream Leads, and consultants.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum 10–12 years of SAP consulting experience, preferably within a recognized SAP consulting or professional services organization.

  • Strong consulting background with progression from a functional SAP role into Functional Lead, Lead Architect, Project Manager, Program Manager, or similar leadership responsibilities.

  • Demonstrated experience leading full life-cycle SAP transformation projects, including SAP S/4HANA programs.

  • Demonstrate prior responsibility for multiple large SAP projects or programs, including at least 3 large projects/programs valued at $2M+.

  • Demonstrated responsibility for major customer engagements and the ability to manage a portfolio or programs representing approximately $5M+ in annual revenue.

  • Strong program and project management capabilities, including scope, budget, resources, risk, governance, and executive stakeholder management.

  • Strong functional SAP expertise in areas such as Finance, Controlling, Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, or related core business processes.

  • Strong end-to-end process knowledge extending beyond an individual SAP module across the full process landscape.

  • Understanding and experience with at least 2 of the relevant SAP transition scenarios (Brownfield, Greenfield, and Selective Data Transition)

  • Experience contributing to sales, presales, and GTM activities.

  • Established customer and market relationships with the ability to support new customer acquisition and account growth.

  • Strong customer-facing, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with an interest in helping build and grow a consulting practice.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience across industries such as:

o Project-based manufacturing

o Discrete Manufacturing

o Process Industry / Chemicals

o Life science and Pharma

o Food and Beverage

o Utilities and Energy

  • Experience developing new customer relationships or opening new markets.

  • Experience helping build consulting capabilities, teams, or service offerings.

  • Experience with SAP transformation methodologies and complex S/4HANA transformation environments.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Experience the energy and enthusiasm of a successful global transformation company. At cbs, we combine our unique services with an infectious team spirit, a dynamic start-up culture, and the sound foundation of a long-standing global business and customer base.

We’d love to hear from you! Don’t hesitate to contact us by phone, email, LinkedIn, or by visiting our application portal.

cbs Corporate Business Solutions America Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Visa sponsorship or transfer of an existing visa is not available for this position. Applicants must be US Citizen or Green Card Holder
